## Raw dump (verbatim)

I run my whole content operation by myself. No team, no employees. The reason I can do that is a set of Claude skills I built. There are 7 of them I reach for constantly. One captures a brain dump and turns it into a structured note. One writes the title. One does the thumbnail. A few more. I want to walk through all 7, show what each one does, and basically hand them over so people can steal them and run the same thing solo. The point is you do not need to hire a content team. You need the skills.

## Topic + angle

The 7 Claude skills that let one person run a whole content operation. Walk through each, show the job it does, hand them over. The leverage promise: a content team's output, no employees.
